name: revinners/shopware6-jtl-connector-guard
description: Guards Shopware data against unwanted overwrites by the JTL-Connector (JTL-Wawi). First feature: customer number write protection.

description.de-DE: Schützt Shopware-Daten (Kundennummern) vor Überschreiben durch den JTL-Connector.
description.en-GB: Protects Shopware data (customer numbers) from being overwritten by the JTL-Connector.
description.pl-PL: Chroni dane Shopware (numery klientów) przed nadpisaniem przez JTL-Connector.
